Installation

Installation from source

$ conda create --name molfrag python=3.11
$ conda activate molfrag
$ git clone https://github.com/ckz1/MolFragApp.git
$ pip install -r requirements.txt

Test your installation

  • Stop firewall (Linux) systemctl stop firewalld

  • Run directly streamlit run MolFragApp.py or run in background nohup streamlit run MolFragApp.py > MolFragApp.log 2>&1 &
